description: This Java class 'UserCreatedShelf' models a user-defined book shelf in the application. It extends the 'Shelf' class, includes JPA annotations for persistence, manages a collection of books, and overrides equality/hashcode methods.

classes.name: UserCreatedShelf
classes.description: Represents a custom shelf created by a user, with a collection of books and associated metadata.

methods.name: setShelfName
methods.description: Sets the shelf name, throwing an exception if the name is blank.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides Object.equals to compare shelf instances based on id, books, and superclass properties.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Overrides Object.hashCode to generate a hash based on superclass, id, and books.
